name: HelpLane Chat
author: helplaneio

sections.description:
HelpLane Chat adds a powerful live chat widget to your WordPress site, enabling real-time customer support directly from your HelpLane dashboard.

Features:

  • Easy setup – just enter your Brand Token
  • Automatic user identification for logged-in users
  • WooCommerce integration – see customer order stats
  • No coding required
  • Lightweight and fast

For WooCommerce Stores:

When WooCommerce is active, the plugin automatically passes customer data to HelpLane:
* Customer order count
* Lifetime value (total spent)
* Currency

This helps your support team provide better, more personalized assistance.

External services

This plugin connects to the HelpLane service to provide live chat functionality on your WordPress site.

Service Provider: HelpLane (helplane.io)

What data is sent and when:

  • The chat widget script is loaded from chat.helplane.io when any page on your site is viewed
  • When a visitor opens the chat widget, their messages are sent to HelpLane servers
  • For logged-in WordPress users, the following data is automatically sent to identify them:
    • User ID
    • Display name
    • Email address
  • When WooCommerce is active, additional customer data may be sent:
    • Order count
    • Total lifetime value (amount spent)
    • Currency

Service links:

  • HelpLane Website
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the helplane-chat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > HelpLane Chat
  4. Enter your Brand Token from your HelpLane dashboard
  5. Save settings – the chat widget will now appear on your site!

New to HelpLane? Create a Free Account:

  1. Go to helplane.io and click “Get Started Free”
  2. Create your account (no credit card required)
  3. Complete the quick setup wizard to create your first brand
  4. Your Brand Token will be shown in Settings > Chat Widget

Already Have a HelpLane Account? Get Your Brand Token:

  1. Log in to your HelpLane dashboard
  2. Click the gear icon to open Settings
  3. Select “Chat Widget” from the menu
  4. Copy your Brand Token from the “Install Widget” section
  5. Paste it in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Brand Token?

Log in to your HelpLane dashboard and go to Settings > Chat Widget. Your Brand Token is displayed there.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The widget script loads asynchronously and won’t block your page from loading.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! When WooCommerce is active, the plugin can automatically pass customer order data to help your support team.

Can I hide the widget on certain pages?

Yes, you can configure hidden URLs in your HelpLane dashboard under Chat Widget settings.
